integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained apart from classical Hall factorization and John contact characterization; exact finite computations are corroboration, not a substitute for universal proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The metric is Euclidean within the degree-equality affine hull. Edge-transitivity (or constant cycle-space projector diagonal) is required for the inball and John-ellipsoid formulas. The circumball formula alone applies to arbitrary connected regular bipartite graphs. No unrestricted Löwner ellipsoid formula or result for irregular graphs is asserted. Historical priority is provisional pending independent audit.
title: Spherical John ellipsoids and universal Euclidean radii of edge-transitive bipartite perfect-matching polytopes
